menu.howto:
A profile is a folder with three files inside the library folder:
  {folder}/<id>/profile.json   {"schemaVersion": 1, "id": "<id>", "name": "...", "description": "..."}
  {folder}/<id>/user.md        the example user message
  {folder}/<id>/assistant.md   the example assistant reply
The id is the folder name: lowercase letters, digits and single hyphens, up to 64 characters. Then choose "Reload the library from disk". Create and Edit in the TUI menu can write profiles; no other action writes to the library.
